experiment: Nordic 28 P2.10 keel hydrodynamic center longitudinal position sensitivity
interpretation_notes: mean_upwind_vmg_kn is actual mean horizontal world velocity projected toward the true wind-from bearing; positive means progress upwind.
runner_target_course_vmg_kn is reported separately because it projects on the commanded heading.
The moved point is only the hydrodynamic force application center in an isolated profile; the visible keel is not moved.

result.failure_reason: target TWA could not be held within the configured error/saturation limits; persisted for the full heading-failure confirmation window

p25_metadata.leeway_definition: signed ground-track angle relative to bow from local vlat/vlong; NaN below 0.15 m/s
p25_metadata.physics_step_note: Engine ticks/time scale are execution acceleration; each observed RigidBody physics delta is checked against the fixed simulated step.
p25_metadata.stw_definition: SOG; no current system is configured and the runner sets water current to zero
p25_metadata.vmg_definition: horizontal world velocity projected onto the target course direction
p25_metadata.wave_definition: WaveSampler remains enabled and is queried by the boat; local sampler amplitude is set to zero for static water
